name: sarmaasis-discovery
description: Public, read-only discovery tools for evaluating Ashish Sharma Backend Engineering: profile, backend services, and engagement availability.
instructions: Use get_profile, list_services, and get_availability to evaluate fit for a full-stack backend engagement. The server is read-only, requires no API key, and exposes only public professional information.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Retrieve Ashish Sharma's public professional profile, specialties, and contact options.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the available public backend engineering services and their concise descriptions.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Retrieve current engagement types, supported regions, currencies, and the next public contact step.
